name: Hegic
rootCause: Hegic: There are 152.2 ETH (about 28,537 USD) permanently locked in the contract pool of unexercised put / call options. Out of the 19 contracts, 16 are put options (DAI is locked) and 3 are call options (ETH is locked). Hegic said it will process a 100% refund for all involved users.

descriptions.text: Hegic: There are 152.2 ETH (about 28,537 USD) permanently locked in the contract pool of unexercised put / call options. Out of the 19 contracts, 16 are put options (DAI is locked) and 3 are call options (ETH is locked). Hegic said it will process a 100% refund for all involved users.

Hegic’s April 2020 Ethereum incident left expired option liquidity locked in the pool contracts after a bug in the unlock path, with DefiLlama recording about $28,537 of impact. A typo in the expired-option liquidity unlock path prevented collateral from being released after expiry, so the affected liquidity stayed locked in the pool contracts.
